messages:
erin (People Ops): Hey team — quick Q. Had to cancel a hotel night in Berlin last week, the hostel refunded to my personal card but I already split the booking with a teammate on the company card. I submitted the expense but they flagged a missing receipt. What documentation do you need?
alex (Finance): You can submit a short attestation + the refund screenshot. We need to see: original company card charge, refund to personal card, and who paid which portion.
sam (Engineering): @erin do you have the booking confirmation and the cancelled night email from the hotel? That usually helps.
morgan (Travel Ops): Also include the split details: who covered which nights and amounts. If the teammate paid part on the company card we need their name + last4.
erin (People Ops): I have the booking confirmation PDF and the refund email (screenshot). Teammate used their company card for the room tax portion only — they gave me a note but no receipt.
alex (Finance): If teammate used company card, we need either their expense line item or a photo of their card statement showing last4 + descriptor. If that's not available, they can do a self-attestation in the expense with manager approval.
erin (People Ops): Manager ok with attestation. What's the exact field in the expense form?
morgan (Travel Ops): On the form pick `Expense type: Lodging (partial refund)` and attach: 1) booking confirmation, 2) refund screenshot, 3) teammate card last4 or attestation, 4) manager approval email.
expenses-bot: Note: Please attach files as PDFs or PNGs under 5MB. Missing receipt flag will remain until uploads done.
alex (Finance): Currency conversion: convert the refund amount to USD using the hotel's refund date FX rate. You can paste the conversion value in the "Expense notes" field and we will verify. Use the internal converter link: https://expenses.redwood.com/fx-convert or paste a third-party rate screenshot.
erin (People Ops): Got it — do I still claim per-diem for meals that night even though I cancelled a night?
morgan (Travel Ops): If you didn't stay that night, no lodging or meals per-diem for that date. If you incurred a dinner because you were still in city, submit meal with receipt. Policy: per-diem applies only to nights stayed.
sam (Engineering): One weird edge: booking had a non-refundable cleaning fee we couldn't get back. Can we claim that?
alex (Finance): Non-refundable fees that are part of the original charge and not refunded can be expensed normally — attach the invoice/confirmation showing the fee line.
erin (People Ops): I'll upload the files now. tagging @alex @morgan :thumbsup:
expenses-bot: File upload received. Expense ID: EXP-20210089. Pending review.
alex (Finance): Thanks. Once we have the attestation + manager approval we'll clear the missing receipt flag and process the refund allocation. Expect ~3 business days for adjustment.
erin (People Ops): Perfect, appreciate the quick help!
